title: Couple Pottery Workshop
description: A hands-on pottery workshop for couples. Learn to make your own ceramic pieces together under the guidance of professional artists.
description_zh: 专业陶艺老师指导，情侣共同制作属于自己的陶艺作品，享受手工创作的乐趣。

title: Weekend Hike at Xiangshan
description: A scenic hiking trip to Xiangshan (Fragrant Hills). Beautiful trails with panoramic views of Beijing. Perfect for active couples who love nature.
description_zh: 香山风景区徒步，沿途欣赏红叶和北京全景。适合喜欢户外运动的情侣。
location_zh: 北京市海淀区香山公园

title: Jazz Night: Romantic Dinner & Live Music
title_zh: 爵士之夜：浪漫晚餐 & 现场演出
description: Enjoy an evening of live jazz music with a candlelit dinner. The perfect setting for a romantic date night in Beijing.
description_zh: 烛光晚餐搭配现场爵士乐演出，为你打造完美的浪漫约会之夜。
location_zh: 北京市东城区Blue Note Beijing

title: Couple's Cooking Class: Italian Cuisine
description: Learn to cook authentic Italian dishes together. From handmade pasta to tiramisu, guided by a professional chef.
description_zh: 学习制作正宗意大利料理，从手工意面到提拉米苏，专业厨师全程指导。

title: Escape Room Challenge: Mystery of the Ancient Palace
description: An immersive escape room experience set in an ancient Chinese palace. Solve puzzles and uncover secrets together!
description_zh: 沉浸式密室逃脱体验，场景设定在古代宫殿。一起破解谜题，揭开秘密！

title: Hot Spring Weekend Getaway
description: A relaxing weekend at a hot spring resort near Beijing. Private pools, spa treatments, and mountain views.
description_zh: 北京近郊温泉度假村的惬意周末，私汤、SPA、山景一应俱全。
